content_raw: I honestly can't stand it when he just leaves his dishes in the sink. It makes me feel like his maid. Does he even respect my time?

She remembered I don't like cilantro. We were at this random taco place and she specifically asked them to hold it on mine. It's such a small thing but it made me feel so seen. Like she actually pays attention to me, you know? I don't think I've ever had someone care about the little things like that.
